description: This file contains utility functions related to tensor sharding in PyTorch's distributed module, including functions to narrow tensors based on offsets and shard metadata.

classes.description: Represents metadata for tensor shards, including offsets and sizes.

methods.description: Narrow the tensor based on shard metadata.
